logp.method_description: The aqueous phase (MilliQ water or DPBS) was saturated for 24 h with octanol. The octanol phase was saturated for 24 h with the aqueous phase. One microliter of a 50 μM solution of the complex in the aqueous phase was added to 1 mL of the octanol phase. The mixture was agitated for 24 h in the dark. The layers were then separated, and the corrected absorbance at 450 nm in each phase was measured. The logP values were calculated as follows: Log P = log(Absorbance450(Octanol) / Absorbance450(Aqueous phase))
